ety: ยืมมาจากเขมร ចាស់ (จาส̍, “เข้ม, แก่”); ร่วมเชื้อสายกับลาว ຈັດ (จัด) ร่วมเชื้อสายกับลาว ຈັດ (จัด)
rule: จัด is two words: the intensifier, to the full, too much (1), ripened into fully aged (2); and the verb to dress (3), narrowed to put in order (4). Excess of manner — a sharp mouth, wandering without end — is 1; seasoned skill is 2, experience as ripeness. Dressing a scene is 3; every word for organising, establishing, allotting, preparing or procuring is 4. Nothing here counts, so 5 takes none.

notes.h2: 2026-09-26 — จะ, จับ, จัด (26 filed, 8 false-split, 2 biological) · the jV- nouns were loans
notes.h3: จัด — two words: to the full, and to arrange
notes.text:
**Unsure.**
* **จรจัด → 1.** "Wandering and homeless" reads as wandering to the extreme.
  No sense fits it cleanly, and 1 fits it best.
* **จัดการ** has a second gloss, ประทุษร้ายหรือฆ่า ("to deal with someone").
  It still files under 4, because "to handle" is where the euphemism comes from.
